_help: Team profiles shown ONLY when the live backend is unavailable (transcribed from the 'Our Experts' posters). Ids must be unique negative numbers. weeklySlots lists the session start times per weekday (full English day names, 24h HH:mm, written in the profile's own timeZone); each slot lasts durationMinutes. A profile may set its own durationMinutes, otherwise defaultDurationMinutes applies. timeZone is REQUIRED per profile and must be an IANA time zone name in Area/City form, case-sensitive: Asia/Jakarta (WIB, UTC+7), Asia/Makassar (WITA, UTC+8), Asia/Jayapura (WIT, UTC+9), Asia/Singapore, Australia/Sydney. Do NOT use abbreviations or offsets such as WIB, GMT+7 or UTC+7. Daylight saving is handled automatically. Leave out acceptsCouple to mean false.
